title: Blank-only same/paired key config emits two overlapping diagnostics ('need join keys' and 'rows cannot be blank')
description: When config carries only blank key rows (e.g. on: [""], or leftOn: [""], rightOn: [""]), hasSameConfig/hasPairedConfig are true (length > 0) while hasSameValues/hasPairedValues are false (some(Boolean) on all-empty is false). Line 144 therefore fires 'Non-cross joins need join keys.' AND line 150's `[...onKeys, ...leftKeys, ...rightKeys].some((key) => key === "")` fires 'Join key rows cannot be blank.' for the same underlying state. The two messages are distinct strings so dedupe() (line 158) does not collapse them, surfacing two warnings for a single empty row. The in-app editor never persists a lone blank row (normalizeKeyRows trims it to []), but imported/decorator/API-sourced configs reach this code path with on:[""], so the redundant pair is user-visible for non-editor configs.
evidence: onKeys for on:[""] is [""] (readKeyList keeps empty strings, lines 240-251). hasSameConfig = onKeys.length>0 = true; hasSameValues = onKeys.some(Boolean) = false. Line 144 condition (how!==cross && !hasSameValues && !hasPairedValues) is true -> push #1. Line 150 condition (some key === "") is true -> push #2. dedupe keeps both because the strings differ.
